headline: Bessent says he still lives on a US military base, promises to pressure Iran
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he still lives on a US military base after receiving unspecified threats from Iran. He pledged to keep applying economic pressure on Iran.
why: Sanctions and economic pressure on Iran affect oil supply expectations, shipping risk and the broader Middle East risk premium that investors price in.
original_headline: Bessent asegura que sigue viviendo en una base militar estadounidense, promete presionar a Irán
